systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène publique et de la Couverture universelle, with UNICEF, Canada, C2D and Mastercard Foundation support
systems.tiers: community health workers (smartphones) and their supervisors (tablets); piloted in the Poro region, being extended to the Gontougo health region with 380 smartphones and 270 tablets handed over on 28 August 2026

note: The only system is mHealth, a platform used by community health workers and their supervisors (class community); the document names no HMIS or EMR and states no exchange with either.
